items_all.title: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Live to take on OpenAI's GPT-Live-1 at a fraction of the cost
items_all.summary: Google Deepmind released Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking, two new audio models for developers that top the Artificial Analysis speech-to-speech leaderboard. At $1.38 per hour of voice conversation, Google significantly undercuts OpenAI's GPT-Live-1, which should still sound more natural thanks to full duplex. The article Google launches Gemini 3.8 Live to take on OpenAI's GPT-Live-1 at a fraction of the cost appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 發布了 Gemini 3.8 Live 與 3.8 Live Extended Thinking，這是兩款面向開發者的全新語音模型，在 Artificial Analysis 的語音對語音排行榜上名列前茅。每小時語音對話的成本為 1.38 美元，Google 大幅低於 OpenAI's GPT-Live-1，後者由於具備全雙工功能，聽起來應該仍然更自然。本文 Google launches Gemini 3.8 Live to take on OpenAI's GPT-Live-1 at a fraction of the cost 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: AI labs have a data trust problem that their policies haven't solved
items_all.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic tell corporate customers their data won't be used for training. But when Anthropic said it would store usage logs from its flagship model Fable for 30 days, Palantir, Nvidia, and Booz Allen Hamilton pulled back from using it for sensitive work. From boardrooms to research labs, AI companies still have a data trust problem. The article AI labs have a data trust problem that their policies haven't solved appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 與 Anthropic 告訴企業客戶，他們的資料將不會被用於訓練。但當 Anthropic 表示將把其旗艦模型 Fable 的使用記錄儲存 30 天時，Palantir、Nvidia 和 Booz Allen Hamilton 便打消了將其用於機密工作的念頭。從董事會到研究實驗室，AI 公司依然面臨資料信任危機。「AI 實驗室面臨政策尚未解決的資料信任危機」一文首先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: After warning AI is too dangerous, Bill Gates bets a billion on its upside
items_all.summary: The Gates Foundation is investing at least a billion dollars over two years to make AI tools more widely available in health, education, and agriculture. Bill Gates warns that more than 90 percent of the training data behind early language models came from English sources, and that speech recognition fails 60 percent of the time in Yoruba. The market, he says, is "a terrible guarantor of equal opportunity." The article After warning AI is too dangerous, Bill Gates bets a billion on its upside appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 蓋茲基金會將在兩年內投資至少十億美元，讓人工智慧工具在醫療、教育和農業領域更為普及。比爾·蓋茲警告稱，早期語言模型背後超過 90% 的訓練資料來自英文來源，且語音辨識在約魯巴語中會有 60% 的機率失敗。他表示，市場「是確保機會均等的糟糕擔保者」。這篇名為「在警告人工智慧過於危險之後，比爾·蓋茲砸下十億美元押注其潛在優勢」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Apple brings a fully revamped Siri built on Google's Gemini, but not to the EU
items_all.summary: Apple is shipping its rebuilt "Siri AI" after years of delay, built on Google's Gemini models and running partly on the device, partly through Private Cloud Compute. Early testers praise multi-step requests and screen context, but report hallucinations and gaps with personal context. In the EU, the assistant stays unavailable for now. The article Apple brings a fully revamped Siri built on Google's Gemini, but not to the EU appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 經過多年的延遲，蘋果 終於推出了重新打造的「Siri AI」，它建立在 Google's Gemini 模型之上，部分功能在裝置端運行，部分則透過 Private Cloud Compute 執行。早期測試者稱讚其多步驟請求與螢幕上下文處理能力，但也回報了幻覺現象以及個人上下文資訊的落差。在歐盟地區，此助理目前仍無法使用。相關文章 蘋果 報導了建構於 Google's Gemini 之上、全面翻新但未登陸歐盟的 Siri，最先出現在 The Decoder。

The article Not everyone is convinced that Big AI's proposed development slowdown is really about safety appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI、Anthropic 與 Google 欲放慢前沿人工智慧的發展腳步，並以安全疑慮為由。但來自產業界與政界各方的批評者正予以反擊。Cohere 執行長 Aidan Gomez 稱該倡議是「換湯不換藥的卡特爾」，旨在排擠競爭對手，白宮與川普本人也反對此舉。這篇題為「並非所有人都相信大型 AI 提議的發展放緩真的與安全有關」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.summary: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google want to slow down frontier AI development, citing safety concerns. But critics from across the industry and politics are pushing back. Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez calls the initiative a "cartel by another name" designed to shut out competitors, and the White House and Trump himself are opposing the move. The article Not everyone is convinced that Big AI's proposed slowdown is really about safety appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI、Anthropic 與 Google 欲放慢前沿人工智慧的發展腳步，並以安全疑慮為由。但來自產業界與政界各方的批評者正予以反擊。Cohere 執行長 Aidan Gomez 稱該倡議是「換湯不換藥的卡特爾」，旨在排擠競爭對手，白宮與川普本人也反對此舉。這篇題為「並非所有人都相信大型 AI 提議的發展放緩真的與安全有關」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: OpenJS CNA面臨AI生成漏洞通報增加，將暫停CVE處理近3週
items_all.summary: OpenJS基金會（OpenJS Foundation）旗下CVE編號授權機構（CNA）宣佈，將於9月17日至10月6日暫停一般資安作業，10月7日恢復。期間一般漏洞通報分類與確認、安全公告驗證，以及CVE編號指派與發布等工作都將暫緩處理。 這段期間，OpenJS CNA仍會接收漏洞通報，但一般通報將延至10月7日恢復作業後再陸續處理；若涉及已遭實際利用的漏洞，或可能立即造成重大風險的資安問題，團隊仍會優先處理。

items_all.title: Salesforce公佈企業AI架構，集中管理自家與第三方AI
items_all.summary: 企業軟體與CRM服務業者Salesforce公佈Enterprise AI Harness企業AI架構，用來支援企業管理AI代理與模型，提供AI運作所需的企業資料、工作執行、資安及治理能力，也可搭配企業原有的第三方模型、AI代理及系統使用。 Salesforce也提出AI控制層（AI Control Plane），讓企業盤點並註冊目前使用的AI代理及相關能力，再建立AI代理的身分與管理政策。AI代理投入運作後，企業還可管理其生命週期、評估效能，並掌握行為、執行結果與使用成本。

items_all.title: Gemini Live audio
items_all.summary: Tool: Gemini Live audio Google released Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking today - two new speech-to-speech models that are a similar shape to OpenAI's GPT-Live family. I pointed GPT-6 Astra Extra High at the documentation and had it build me this web UI for trying out the new models. You can select a model and voice preset, enter an optional system prompt and then start a voice conversation through your browser, including the ability to interrupt the model while it is talking. The implementation uses no libraries. It connects to the wss://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/ws/google.ai.generativelanguage.v1alpha.GenerativeService.BidiGenerateContent?key=... WebSocket endpoint and uses a Web Audio API AudioContext for both capture and playback. Here's the Gemini Live tutorial for getting started with that WebSockets API. Tags: google , tools , websockets , generative-ai , llms , gemini , llm-release , speech-to-text
items_all.summary_zh: 工具：Gemini Live audio Google 於今日發布了 Gemini 3.8 Live 與 3.8 Live Extended Thinking——這兩個全新的語音對語音模型，其外形與 OpenAI's GPT-Live 系列相似。我將 GPT-6 Astra Extra High 指向該說明文件，並讓它為我建構了這個網頁介面，以便試用這些新模型。你可以選擇模型與語音預設、輸入選用的系統提示詞，然後透過瀏覽器開始語音對話，包含在模型發言時打斷它的功能。此實作未使用任何函式庫。它連接至 wss://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/ws/google.ai.generativelanguage.v1alpha.GenerativeService.BidiGenerateContent?key=... WebSocket 端點，並使用 Web Audio API AudioContext 進行音訊擷取與播放。這裡是用於開始使用該 WebSockets API 的 Gemini Live 教學。標籤：google、tools、websockets、generative-ai、llms、gemini、llm-release、speech-to-text

items_all_raw.title: AWS評測12款頂尖AI模型，皆能找出漏洞但誤判或漏報率仍高
items_all_raw.summary: 雲端服務業者AWS公佈AI漏洞判斷基準Deception Benchmark，評測5家業者共12款通用頂尖AI模型後發現，現有模型雖能找出多數真正漏洞，但若以誤報率、漏報率都低於10%作為實際用於漏洞判斷的最低門檻，沒有任何受測模型組態能同時達標。

items_all_raw.summary: 雲端服務業者AWS公佈AI漏洞判斷基準Deception Benchmark，評測5家業者共12款通用頂尖AI模型後發現，現有模型雖能找出多數真正漏洞，但若以誤報率、漏報率都低於10%作為實際用於漏洞判斷的最低門檻，沒有任何受測模型組態能同時達標。

items_all_raw.title: ​Salesforce 聯手英偉達推出 Koa 推理大模型，向閉源 AI 巨頭宣戰
items_all_raw.summary: Salesforce在Dreamforce大會發布首款推理大模型Koa，基於英偉達開源Nemotron底座，雙方聯合微調，聚焦銷售、營銷、客服等企業核心場景。此舉意在降低企業智能化轉型成本，避免閉源AI要求上傳內部文件、代碼、提示詞及用戶反饋所帶來的數據風險。

items_all_raw.title: Gemini Live audio
items_all_raw.summary: Tool: Gemini Live audio Google released Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking today - two new speech-to-speech models that are a similar shape to OpenAI's GPT-Live family. I pointed GPT-6 Astra Extra High at the documentation and had it build me this web UI for trying out the new models. You can select a model and voice preset, enter an optional system prompt and then start a voice conversation through your browser, including the ability to interrupt the model while it is talking. The implementation uses no libraries. It connects to the wss://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/ws/google.ai.generativelanguage.v1alpha.GenerativeService.BidiGenerateContent?key=... WebSocket endpoint and uses a Web Audio API AudioContext for both capture and playback. Here's the Gemini Live tutorial for getting started with that WebSockets API. Tags: google , tools , websockets , generative-ai , llms , gemini , llm-release , speech-to-text
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 工具：Gemini Live audio Google 於今日發布了 Gemini 3.8 Live 與 3.8 Live Extended Thinking——這兩個全新的語音對語音模型，其外形與 OpenAI's GPT-Live 系列相似。我將 GPT-6 Astra Extra High 指向該說明文件，並讓它為我建構了這個網頁介面，以便試用這些新模型。你可以選擇模型與語音預設、輸入選用的系統提示詞，然後透過瀏覽器開始語音對話，包含在模型發言時打斷它的功能。此實作未使用任何函式庫。它連接至 wss://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/ws/google.ai.generativelanguage.v1alpha.GenerativeService.BidiGenerateContent?key=... WebSocket 端點，並使用 Web Audio API AudioContext 進行音訊擷取與播放。這裡是用於開始使用該 WebSockets API 的 Gemini Live 教學。標籤：google、tools、websockets、generative-ai、llms、gemini、llm-release、speech-to-text

items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic tell corporate customers their data won't be used for training. But when Anthropic said it would store usage logs from its flagship model Fable for 30 days, Palantir, Nvidia, and Booz Allen Hamilton pulled back from using it for sensitive work. From boardrooms to research labs, AI companies still have a data trust problem. The article AI labs have a data trust problem that their policies haven't solved appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenAI 與 Anthropic 告訴企業客戶，他們的資料將不會被用於訓練。但當 Anthropic 表示將把其旗艦模型 Fable 的使用記錄儲存 30 天時，Palantir、Nvidia 和 Booz Allen Hamilton 便打消了將其用於機密工作的念頭。從董事會到研究實驗室，AI 公司依然面臨資料信任危機。「AI 實驗室面臨政策尚未解決的資料信任危機」一文首先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: After warning AI is too dangerous, Bill Gates bets a billion on its upside
items_all_raw.summary: The Gates Foundation is investing at least a billion dollars over two years to make AI tools more widely available in health, education, and agriculture. Bill Gates warns that more than 90 percent of the training data behind early language models came from English sources, and that speech recognition fails 60 percent of the time in Yoruba. The market, he says, is "a terrible guarantor of equal opportunity." The article After warning AI is too dangerous, Bill Gates bets a billion on its upside appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 蓋茲基金會將在兩年內投資至少十億美元，讓人工智慧工具在醫療、教育和農業領域更為普及。比爾·蓋茲警告稱，早期語言模型背後超過 90% 的訓練資料來自英文來源，且語音辨識在約魯巴語中會有 60% 的機率失敗。他表示，市場「是確保機會均等的糟糕擔保者」。這篇名為「在警告人工智慧過於危險之後，比爾·蓋茲砸下十億美元押注其潛在優勢」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Apple brings a fully revamped Siri built on Google's Gemini, but not to the EU
items_all_raw.summary: Apple is shipping its rebuilt "Siri AI" after years of delay, built on Google's Gemini models and running partly on the device, partly through Private Cloud Compute. Early testers praise multi-step requests and screen context, but report hallucinations and gaps with personal context. In the EU, the assistant stays unavailable for now. The article Apple brings a fully revamped Siri built on Google's Gemini, but not to the EU appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 經過多年的延遲，蘋果 終於推出了重新打造的「Siri AI」，它建立在 Google's Gemini 模型之上，部分功能在裝置端運行，部分則透過 Private Cloud Compute 執行。早期測試者稱讚其多步驟請求與螢幕上下文處理能力，但也回報了幻覺現象以及個人上下文資訊的落差。在歐盟地區，此助理目前仍無法使用。相關文章 蘋果 報導了建構於 Google's Gemini 之上、全面翻新但未登陸歐盟的 Siri，最先出現在 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Not everyone is convinced that Big AI's proposed slowdown is really about safety
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google want to slow down frontier AI development, citing safety concerns. But critics from across the industry and politics are pushing back. Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez calls the initiative a "cartel by another name" designed to shut out competitors, and the White House and Trump himself are opposing the move. The article Not everyone is convinced that Big AI's proposed slowdown is really about safety appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenAI、Anthropic 與 Google 欲放慢前沿人工智慧的發展腳步，並以安全疑慮為由。但來自產業界與政界各方的批評者正予以反擊。Cohere 執行長 Aidan Gomez 稱該倡議是「換湯不換藥的卡特爾」，旨在排擠競爭對手，白宮與川普本人也反對此舉。這篇題為「並非所有人都相信大型 AI 提議的發展放緩真的與安全有關」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: OpenJS CNA面臨AI生成漏洞通報增加，將暫停CVE處理近3週
items_all_raw.summary: OpenJS基金會（OpenJS Foundation）旗下CVE編號授權機構（CNA）宣佈，將於9月17日至10月6日暫停一般資安作業，10月7日恢復。期間一般漏洞通報分類與確認、安全公告驗證，以及CVE編號指派與發布等工作都將暫緩處理。 這段期間，OpenJS CNA仍會接收漏洞通報，但一般通報將延至10月7日恢復作業後再陸續處理；若涉及已遭實際利用的漏洞，或可能立即造成重大風險的資安問題，團隊仍會優先處理。

items_all_raw.title: Salesforce公佈企業AI架構，集中管理自家與第三方AI
items_all_raw.summary: 企業軟體與CRM服務業者Salesforce公佈Enterprise AI Harness企業AI架構，用來支援企業管理AI代理與模型，提供AI運作所需的企業資料、工作執行、資安及治理能力，也可搭配企業原有的第三方模型、AI代理及系統使用。 Salesforce也提出AI控制層（AI Control Plane），讓企業盤點並註冊目前使用的AI代理及相關能力，再建立AI代理的身分與管理政策。AI代理投入運作後，企業還可管理其生命週期、評估效能，並掌握行為、執行結果與使用成本。

items_all_raw.title: 曝 Anthropic、OpenAI 與谷歌祕密磋商：籌建 AI 安全標準機構
items_all_raw.summary: 知情人士透露，Anthropic、OpenAI與谷歌早在Anthropic CEO公開呼籲前，已就聯合成立AI行業標準機構展開磋商。自7月起，三家公司CEO層級以下代表組成工作組定期開會。OpenAI CEO奧特曼也在內部表示支持設立AI測試與審計機構。
